{{Top|rwp|sprot}} {{Otheruses|Kathleen}} {{Expand|this page needs expanding on [Biography].}} {{Person |image=[[File:KathleenKennedy.jpg]] |name=Kathleen Kennedy |birth= |death= |listedpronouns= |nationality=[[Wikipedia:Americans|American]]{{WebCite|url=https://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/2019/10/kathleen-kennedy-star-wars-royal-honor-cbe|text=Lucasfilm president Kathleen Kennedy named Commander of the British Empire|author=Breznican, Anthony|date=2019-10-18|work=[[Wikipedia:Vanity Fair (magazine)|''Vanity Fair'']]|archivedate=20191020173847}} |occupation=[[Wikipedia:Film producer|Film producer]]{{Lucasfilm|url=our-team/kathleen-kennedy|text=Kathleen Kennedy}} |companies=[[Lucasfilm]] |website= }} {{Quote|Story, at the most basic level, is a fiction designed to unify people.|Kathleen Kennedy|}} '''Kathleen Kennedy''' [[Wikipedia:Order of the British Empire|CBE]] is a film producer and the President of [[Lucasfilm]] from [[2012]] to [[2026]]. She succeeded Lucasfilm's founder and ''Star Wars'' creator, [[George Lucas]], in [[2012]], being personally chosen for the role by Lucas shortly before he sold the company to the [[The Walt Disney Company]].{{WebCite|url=https://deadline.com/2026/01/kathleen-kennedy-exit-interview-1236665253|text=A Shift In The Force For Lucasfilm’s Kathleen Kennedy: The Exit Interview|author=Mike Flemming Jr.|date=2026-01-15|work=[[Wikipedia:Deadline Hollywood|''Deadline'']]|archivedate=20260115233219}} Kennedy served as executive producer for all three films of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[sequel trilogy]] as well as other ''Star Wars'' standalone films and live-action and animated television series. Kennedy, [[Frank Marshall]], and [[Steven Spielberg]] also co-founded the film production company [[Wikipedia:Amblin Entertainment|Amblin Entertainment]] in [[1981]]. Amblin is behind many of the over seventy films that were produced or executive produced by Kennedy, including her first producing credits on ''[[Wikipedia:Poltergeist (1982 film)|Poltergeist]]'' and ''[[Wikipedia:E.T. The Extra-Terrestrial|E.T. The Extra-Terrestrial]]''. In total her produced films have grossed a combined 11 Billion [[Wikipedia:US Dollar|US Dollar]]s globally. Kennedy and her husband Frank Marshall also co-founded the The Kennedy/Marshall Company in [[1992]]. Kennedy is also a recipient of numerous film production awards and has been nominated eight times for an [[Wikipedia:Academy Awards|Academy Award]], and she also sits on numerous boards, including chairing the [[Wikipedia:American Film Institute|American Film Institute's]] board of trustees and was the President of the [[Wikipedia:Producers Guild of America|Producers Guild of America]] from [[2001]] to [[2002]].{{WebCite|url=http://www.producersguild.org/?page=history|text=History|archivedate=20171202200556|nolive=1}} After leaving Lucasfilm, Kathleen Kennedy intends to return to full-time producing other movies. ==Biography== {{Quote|I racked my brain to figure out who do I trust and who do I know really well and is level-headed, who understands the business side of it but also understands the creative side of it. And finally I banged into it and said, 'Oh, my God, it's Kathy.'|George Lucas, on choosing someone to run Lucasfilm|{{WebCite|url=https://fortune.com/2015/09/10/kathleen-kennedy-lucasfilm-star-wars|text=How the Star Wars producer went from secretary to studio boss|author=Lev-ram, Michal|date=2015-09-10|work=[[Wikipedia:Fortune (magazine)|''Fortune'']]|archivedate=20220802203223}}}} When Kathleen Kennedy became President of [[Lucasfilm]]{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess#!asset/gppr5wpqgb4t74974f8s|text=ANDOR Production Brief V3 FINAL 8-04-22|author=[[Gina McIntyre|McIntyre, Gina]]|date=2022-08-04}} in [[2012]], she aimed to rejuvenate ''[[Star Wars]]'' with a new era of films after fans felt underwhelmed from the [[prequel trilogy]].{{WebCite|url=https://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/2022/05/star-wars-cover-the-rebellion-will-be-televised|date=2022-05-17|text=''Star Wars:'' The Rebellion Will Be Televised|author=Breznican, Anthony|archivedate=20250308161156}} Her position has her overseeing Lucasfilm, [[Industrial Light & Magic]], and [[Skywalker Sound]]. Kennedy was the producer of [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], the first film in the new [[sequel trilogy]]. She also produced ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']], ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'', and [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']]. By [[2018]], [[Lucasfilm]] had begun developing a television series set before ''Rogue One'' which starred [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] and [[K-2SO]].{{WebCite|url=https://variety.com/2022/tv/news/star-wars-andor-tony-gilroy-diego-luna-1235348148|text=How ‘Andor' Became the First ‘Star Wars' TV Series for Grown-Ups: ‘I Wanted to Do It About Real People'|author=Vary, Adam B|work=[[Wikipedia:Variety (magazine)|''Variety'']]|archivedate=20220824140042}} Kennedy sent{{WebCite|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-features/andor-creator-tony-gilroy-views-on-star-wars-1235226261|text=‘Andor' Creator Tony Gilroy Urged His Team to Put Aside Their ‘Star Wars' Reverence|author=Davids, Brian|date=2022-09-23|work=[[Wikipedia:The Hollywood Reporter|''The Hollywood Reporter'']]|archivedate=20220923175300}} the script for one of the pilots to director [[Tony Gilroy]] and asked for his opinion. Gilroy then wrote a forensic manifesto for Kennedy explaining why the idea would not work and what Lucasfilm should do instead. In early [[2019]], months before the release of ''The Rise of Skywalker'', Kennedy announced that Lucasfilm would take a hiatus to regroup and rethink. Lucasfilm recognized that they needed to work together to create the architecture of the next chapter of the company. They learned that ''Star Wars'' needs filmmakers with a professional devotion. [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]] wanted something as big as the films for the release of [[Disney+]], so Kennedy first turned to filmmaker [[Jon Favreau]] who said he had an idea. After their meeting at Kennedy's office, Favreau started writing without a contract. His idea was about a [[Mandalorian]], but Kennedy realized [[Dave Filoni]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' series already focused on Mandalorians. She arranged a meeting between Favreau and Filoni in [[Wikipedia:Los Angeles|Los Angeles]] where they both combined their ideas for a Mandalorian show. Kennedy was an executive producer for ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]''. In October, 2019, Kennedy was made an honorary [[Wikipedia:Order of the British Empire|Commander of the Order of the British Empire]] by [[Wikipedia:Monarchy of the United Kingdom|Queen]] [[Wikipedia:Elizabeth II|Elizabeth II]] for her contributions to the [[Wikipedia:United Kingdom|United Kingdom's]] film industry. Kennedy worked as an executive producer for ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'' and the ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'' television series. In [[January]], [[2020]], she announced that an overhaul for the latter series was in order. She temporarily shut down production and hired writer [[Joby Harold]] to take over from [[Hossein Amini]].{{WebCite|url=https://ew.com/tv/obi-wan-kenobi-ewan-mcgregor-hayden-christensen-cover-story|text=Inside the 17-year journey to reunite Ewan McGregor and Hayden Christensen for ''Obi-Wan Kenobi''|author=Ross, Dalton|date=2022-03-10|work=''[[Entertainment Weekly]]''|archivedate=20220310151626}} [[Moses Ingram]], the actor who played the [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]], received [[Reva's double-bladed Inquisitor Lightsaber|her lightsaber]] as a gift from Kennedy.{{WebCite|url=https://ew.com/tv/star-wars-obi-wan-kenobi-moses-ingram-reva-hair|text=How Moses Ingram made a ''Star Wars'' Halloween character for Black girls on ''Obi-Wan Kenobi''|author=Ross, Dalton|date=2022-04-06|work=''[[Entertainment Weekly]]''|archivedate=20220406163044}} Kennedy and the crew often talked about a possible extension because "everybody came together and had such an incredible time." She said they'd have to question why before making any extensions to the show. Kennedy, Gilroy, [[Sanne Wohlenberg]], [[Diego Luna]], and [[Michelle Rejwan]] served as executive producers for the ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' television series. Kennedy and the crew felt fortunate to have Luna reprise his role as Cassian Andor in the show. They all felt it was important to show how Andor's background defined his character. Kennedy and Gilroy gave composer [[Nicholas Britell]] "total freedom" to imagine a unique soundscape for the series.{{WebCite|url=https://variety.com/2022/artisans/news/andor-composer-nicholas-britell-score-star-wars-1235383443|text=‘Andor' Composer Nicholas Britell Breaks Down His Score and Why He Incorporated Rustling Leaves|author=Burlingame, Jon|date=2022-09-26|work=[[Wikipedia:Variety (magazine)|''Variety'']]|archivedate=20220926170019}} When Gilroy first heard Britell play his theme for the series, he called Kennedy and told her they had a theme. Kennedy was impressed by how production designer [[Luke Hull]] was able to make the [[Ferrix]] set look real and grounded as well as feel like ''Star Wars''. She was excited for the audience to discover how ''Star Wars'' can be different genres. In [[September]], [[2022]], Kennedy attended the ''Andor'' launch event in [[Wikipedia:Hollywood, Los Angeles|Hollywood]], [[Wikipedia:California|California]].{{SWYouTube|Fv6hHyIToC0|Diego Luna and the Cast and Crew of Andor}} On [[January 15]], [[2026]], Lucasfilm publicly announced that Kennedy would step down as president and leave the company{{SW|url=news/lucasfilm-leadership|text=Lucasfilm and the Walt Disney Studios Announce Leadership Transition}} the following months. She will be succeeded by [[Dave Filoni]] as Chief Creative Officer and Co-President together with former Lucasfilm Executive Vice President and General Manager [[Lynwen Brennan]]. Kennedy's departure and successors had been planned by her together with Disney's [[Bob Iger (chief executive officer)|Bob Iger]] and [[Alan Bergman]] for two years prior and her departure was previously reported and confirmed in February [[2025]].{{WebCite|url=https://deadline.com/2025/02/kathleen-kennedy-clarifies-lucasfilm-exit-star-wars-future-1236304421|text=Kathleen Kennedy Speaks On Her Lucasfilm Plans — She Is Not Soon Retiring — & The Films That Will Keep Her In 'Star Wars' Orbit For Years To Come|author=Mike Flemming Jr.|date=2025-02-27|work=[[Wikipedia:Deadline|''Deadline'']]|archivedate=20250228034942}} Though stepping down as president, Kennedy will still serve as producer on the upcoming films [[Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu|''The Mandalorian and Grogu'']] and ''[[Star Wars: Starfighter]]'' and is open to produce future ''Star Wars'' projects as an external producer if asked. ==Works== {{IncompleteList|oou=1}} ===Filmography===
